name: wardrobe
description: Restyle Claude Code live, including colourblind-safe and high-contrast themes.

dayTheme.title: Day theme (auto mode)
dayTheme.description: The theme /wear auto wears by day.

nightTheme.title: Night theme (auto mode)
nightTheme.description: The theme /wear auto wears by night.

dayStarts.title: Day starts at
dayStarts.description: When auto mode switches to the day theme, 24-hour HH:MM local time.

nightStarts.title: Night starts at
nightStarts.description: When auto mode switches to the night theme, 24-hour HH:MM local time.

matchTheme.title: Match Claude Code's theme
matchTheme.description: Wearing a look also sets Claude Code's own theme to match it; /wear default puts yours back. Off, only /wear <theme> --match does.

teamPrimary.title: Team colour, first
teamPrimary.description: Your team's main colour as a hex code like #1f4e9c. The sports looks (hardwood, gridiron, rink) wear it. Empty keeps each look's own.

teamSecondary.title: Team colour, second
teamSecondary.description: Your team's second colour as a hex code like #f2b824. Empty keeps each look's own.

gameDay.title: Game day
gameDay.description: The weekdays your team plays, like sunday or sat sun. On those days /wear auto and /wear season wear the game look. Empty for none.

gameLook.title: Game look
gameLook.description: The sports look a game day wears.

motion.title: Scene motion
motion.description: How much the scene behind the chat moves: full, calm (half as much, half as fast) or still.

glass.title: Glass over the scene
glass.description: How heavily the desktop app frosts its panels over the scene: light shows more of it, heavy less.

seasonEaster.title: Easter in season mode
seasonEaster.description: /wear season wears the easter look from Good Friday to Easter Monday (the Western date).

seasonEid.title: Eid al-Fitr in season mode
seasonEid.description: /wear season wears the eid look on Eid al-Fitr and the two days after. The day follows the Umm al-Qura calendar; where you live it may fall a day either side.
